lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The centroids follow a semi-regular grid pattern with higher density in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly in the anterior-mid section of the flank, forming a visible coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), running parallel to the longitudinal axis.
